method: Three possible whole launch prices from the archived DT-trained, register-packed epoch model, evaluated using target per-core rates and chip DMA limits. Feasible H values only (no expansion when active=1). Robust point = 2*min(price)*max(price)/(min(price)+max(price)). No known H, mixed state proportions, sample lookup or test labels used to price an invocation.
roles: 54 historical windows form development replay including DT stage calibration and PR transfer; the following 30 windows were independent for v0.26. Their results were published before choosing this diagnostic; they are heldout-trace replay, not new prospective evidence for the robust point.

excluded_weak_repeats.reason: mixed sqlite NPUSIM / msopprof shard measurement paths, both isolated first; not a first-versus-reuse pair
